visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: One Side of the Swap Is Missing
visualizerParams.problemDescription: order(&a, &b) should put the smaller number first and print 4 9, but the program prints 9 9.

solution.explanation: low = high copies the pointer, not the number it points to, so the caller's variable keeps its old value while *high is overwritten with temp. Both variables end up holding 9. Assign through the pointer: *low = *high.
